en.ansChangesBody: Changes to ANS VibeHub content and experience, with a destination for every note.
en.ansChangesEdition: From glossary to creative starting point
en.ansChangesDateNote: Dates record the changes, not their deployment.
en.ansChangecontentBody: Six bilingual ANS practices cover briefs, portfolios, creative delivery, open-source reuse, competition evidence, and material and cost boundaries. Each includes a copyable brief and real destinations.
en.ansChangepathsBody: Three original paths focus on your website, creative delivery and open-source projects. Actions, deliverables and resources sit together. You mark your own progress, saved on this device.
en.ansChangecollaborationTitle: Give your Agent an actionable brief
en.ansChangecollaborationBody: The collaboration page turns your goal, material, deliverables and acceptance criteria into a copyable brief. The interactive lab now uses actual content counts instead of invented adoption and ratings.
en.ansChangeidentityBody: ANS branding, typography and theme carry through. Homepage covers summarize this site’s terms, original practices and quizzes. The return entry preserves the ANS page and scroll position you came from.
en.ansChangesSourceTitle: Keep the sources. Find our own direction.
en.ansChangesSourceBody: Terminology, diagrams and foundation courses retain VibeHub attribution. ANS adds practices, paths, brief preparation and these change notes. The original product history is not presented as ANS release history.
en.pathDeviceNote: You mark the steps yourself. Progress is stored on this device and does not sync with your account.

en.pathCompleteBody: You have marked all steps complete. Bring your real material and delivery notes to continue your project in the ANS workspace.
en.pathStartSmallTitle: Not sure where to start? Write the brief.
en.pathStartSmallBody: Describe what you want to make, what you have and what you need delivered. A clear small goal is a good beginning.
en.pathSourceBody: The source site’s foundation paths remain available as supplementary material, distinct from original ANS paths.
en.courseDirectoryBody: Build foundations in websites and version control, then apply them to your own content. ANS practice paths connect the steps.
en.websiteCourseTitle: From the first screen to a working website
en.websiteCourseBody: Understand page structure, visual hierarchy and real interactions. Learn to give an Agent specific revision requests.
en.websiteCourseStep1: Organize content: structure, visual direction, hero and actions
en.websiteCourseStep2: Build the page: layout, evidence, forms and interactions
en.websiteCourseStep3: Deliver: responsive layouts, review and iteration
en.gitCourseBody: Save versions, inspect differences and isolate experiments before bringing reviewed changes into the project.
en.gitCourseStep1: Save and compare: commits, diffs and ignore rules
en.gitCourseStep2: Isolate and integrate: branches, merges and conflicts
en.gitCourseStep3: Collaborate and recover: remotes, undo and stash
en.courseBridgeTitle: Learn a chapter. Make one small change.
en.courseBridgeBody: Revise a brief, organize a project example or inspect one control. Applying knowledge to real material makes it your own method.
en.courseSourceNote: Foundation courses and diagrams come from VibeHub. This introduction, original practices and project paths are authored by ANS.
en.agentTitle: Help your Agent understand the brief.
en.agentBody: State the goal, provide real material and define delivery and acceptance. Turn a vague idea into work you can advance together.
en.agentPrinciples: Three principles for working with an Agent
en.agentPrinciple1Body: Keep material sourced and gaps explicit. Do not ask a model to invent your experience, projects or progress.
en.agentPrinciple2Body: Explain who will use the result, what they need to do and which files or pages should be delivered.
en.agentPrinciple3Body: Check preview, persistence, export and publication as separate actual outcomes.
en.agentBriefBody: Your inputs become a copyable collaboration brief.
en.agentPlaceholdergoal: Purpose, audience and the one most important task
en.agentPlaceholdermaterial: Real copy, assets and file locations; include what is missing
en.agentPlaceholderdelivery: Pages, editable files, export formats and scope
en.agentPlaceholderacceptance: Behavior and appearance to inspect, plus content that must be preserved
en.agentDraftNote: Drafts stay on this device. They are not sent to an Agent or synced with your account. Do not enter credentials here.
en.agentBriefOpening: Help me complete this project using the following real material and requirements:
en.agentBriefConstraint: Follow ANS branding, theme and existing components. Flag missing facts; do not invent content or progress. Distinguish local preview, persistence, export and publication. Provide inspectable results and outstanding work at handoff.
en.agentBriefPreviewNote: Review missing inputs and add your own material before copying.
en.agentBriefGuide: How to write a complete brief
en.agentSourceTitle: Additional tool · Terminology skill and source
en.agentSourceBody: The upstream VibeHub skill helps identify terminology. It belongs to its original author; this brief builder and ANS practices are authored by ANS. Downloading a skill does not provide a backend, database or deployment.

zh.ansChangesBody: 记录 ANS VibeHub 自己的内容与体验改进。每条记录，都能找到对应的页面。
zh.ansChangesDateNote: 日期为改动记录日期，不代表上线时间。
zh.ansChangecontentTitle: 把方法写进自己的实践
zh.ansChangecontentBody: 加入六份中英文 ANS 实践：需求表达、个人网站、创作交付、开源复用、比赛证据、资料与费用。每份都有可复制需求和真实去向。
zh.ansChangepathsTitle: 从想学什么，变成想做什么
zh.ansChangepathsBody: 围绕自己的网站、创作交付和开源项目建立三条原创路径。把行动、交付标准与资料放在一起，完成情况由自己勾选，保存在当前设备。
zh.ansChangecollaborationTitle: 给 Agent 一份能执行的需求
zh.ansChangecollaborationBody: 协作页可以填写目标、资料、交付与验收，实时整理成可复制文本。实验室沿用交互练习，用实际内容数量替换虚构用户数和评分。
zh.ansChangeidentityTitle: 回到 ANS 熟悉的样子
zh.ansChangeidentityBody: 沿用 ANS 图标、字体和主题。首页封面概括本站的术语、原创实践与练习；返回入口记住进入前的 ANS 页面和滚动位置。
zh.ansChangesSourceTitle: 复用有来处，改进有自己的方向。
zh.ansChangesSourceBody: 术语、图解与基础课程保留 VibeHub 来源；ANS 新增实践、路径、需求整理和本站改进记录。原作者的产品历史不作为 ANS 的发布历史。
zh.ansChangesSourceLink: 了解我们的开源复用方法

zh.pathCompleteTitle: 这一轮，有了自己的成果。
zh.pathCompleteBody: 你已勾选全部步骤。带上真实资料与交付记录，继续在 ANS 工作台推进自己的项目。
zh.pathStartSmallTitle: 还没选好？先把需求写下来。
zh.pathStartSmallBody: 写清楚你想做什么、已经有什么，以及完成后要交付什么。一个明确的小目标，就是不错的开始。
zh.pathSourceTitle: 更多基础路径 · VibeHub 来源
zh.pathSourceBody: 保留原站的基础学习路径作为补充资料，内容来源与 ANS 原创路径分开标明。
zh.courseDirectoryBody: 先补齐网站与版本管理的基础，再把知识用到自己的内容中。ANS 实践路径帮你把每一步接起来。
zh.websiteCourseTitle: 从第一屏，到一个能用的网站
zh.websiteCourseBody: 理解页面结构、视觉层级和真实交互，学会向 Agent 提出具体的修改要求。
zh.websiteCourseStep1: 组织内容：页面结构、视觉方向、首屏与行动
zh.websiteCourseStep2: 完成页面：布局、真实证据、表单与交互
zh.websiteCourseStep3: 做好交付：手机适配、检查与协作迭代
zh.gitCourseTitle: 让每一次修改，都有迹可循
zh.gitCourseBody: 保存版本、看懂差异、隔离尝试，再把经过检查的改动带回项目。
zh.gitCourseStep1: 保存与比较：提交、Diff 与忽略规则
zh.gitCourseStep2: 隔离与整合：分支、合并与冲突处理
zh.gitCourseStep3: 协作与恢复：远程仓库、撤销与暂存
zh.courseBridgeTitle: 学完一章，就做一个小改动。
zh.courseBridgeBody: 改一段需求、整理一个项目案例，或检查一处按钮。知识用到真实内容里，才成为自己的方法。
zh.courseSourceNote: 基础课程与图解来自 VibeHub；本页导学、原创实践与项目路径由 ANS 编写。
zh.agentTitle: 让 Agent 更懂你的要求。
zh.agentBody: 先说清目标，再给真实资料，最后约定交付与验收。把模糊的想法，整理成可以一起推进的工作。
zh.agentPrinciples: 与 Agent 协作的三个要点
zh.agentPrinciple1Body: 资料有来源，缺项明确留空。自己的经历、项目与进度，不交给模型补写。
zh.agentPrinciple2Body: 说明谁会使用、需要完成什么，以及交付的文件或页面。
zh.agentPrinciple3Body: 能预览、已保存、已导出和已上线，分别查看实际结果。
zh.agentBriefBody: 填写后，右侧会整理成一份可复制的协作需求。
zh.agentPlaceholdergoal: 用途、使用者，以及最重要的一件事
zh.agentPlaceholdermaterial: 真实文字、素材、文件位置；也写出缺少什么
zh.agentPlaceholderdelivery: 页面、可编辑文件、导出格式，以及交付范围
zh.agentPlaceholderacceptance: 要检查的功能、效果与不能改动的内容
zh.agentDraftNote: 草稿仅保存在当前设备，不会自动发给 Agent 或同步到账号。请勿在这里填写密钥。
zh.agentBriefOpening: 请根据以下真实资料与要求协助我完成项目：
zh.agentBriefConstraint: 沿用 ANS 的品牌、主题和已有组件。缺失事实先标明，不虚构内容或完成进度。明确区分本地预览、保存、导出与上线；交付时给出可查看的真实结果和仍未完成的事项。
zh.agentBriefPreview: 可以发给 Agent 的需求
zh.agentBriefPreviewNote: 复制前检查缺项，再补上你自己的资料。
zh.agentBriefGuide: 看看一份完整需求怎么写

zh.agentSourceBody: VibeHub 的开源 Skill 可以辅助识别术语。它属于原作者的项目；本页需求整理与 ANS 实践由 ANS 编写。下载 Skill 不等于具备后台、数据库或部署能力。
